summary: Douglas County lookout on Mace Mountain: an L-5 cab built in 1934 and removed around 1960; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-5 cab on a minor point east of Old Fairview Mountain
facts.status_note: Removed around 1960 per the register, destroyed in 1960 per firelookout.com; no source describes what remains

events.note: Roseburg Chieftain item of September 14, 1933 planned a CCC-built 10 x 10 lookout (quoted by Rex's page)
Register and firelookout.com both give 1934; a 1933 newspaper item quoted by Rex's page had planned a CCC-built 10 x 10 lookout
Register says removed around 1960; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1960; Rex's page says removed 1960

evidence.supports: built in 1934 atop a minor point east of Old Fairview Mountain as an L-5 cab, removed around 1960
evidence.quote: Built in 1934 atop a minor point 1 1/4 miles east of Old Fairview Mountain, this L-5 cab was removed around 1960.

evidence.supports: site lies about 26 miles northeast of Roseburg
site is in Douglas County, Oregon
September 14, 1933 newspaper item planned a CCC-built 10 x 10 lookout, the standard secondary size
evidence.quote: September 14, 1933: "A 10 x 10 lookout is to be constructed by the CCC before the snow flies. The 10 x 10 is the standard size of a secondary lookout."

evidence.supports: register photo caption gives a 1933 to 1965 span, which does not match the 1960 removal

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1933 newspaper item quoted by Rex's page planned a CCC-built lookout. The register and firelookout.com date the lookout to 1934, so the story uses 1934 as the build year and mentions the 1933 plan.
The register and Rex's page say removed around 1960 or in 1960, while firelookout.com says destroyed in 1960. The story says the cab was gone around 1960 and reports both words.

sources.title: Mace Mountain
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (Oregon), Rex's Fire Lookout Page

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 1934 build (or the 1933 plan) and the removal around 1960, but they disagree on the word removed or destroyed. No staffing record was found in these sources, so staffing is omitted. No source describes the site today, so access is omitted. The register photo caption 'Mace Mountain Lookout 1933 - 1965' is left as an unresolved conflict with the 1960 date; the editor may want to check the photo's source. The brief's 2011 FFLOS registration date was not visible in the register text read, so it is not repeated. A search also surfaced a Douglas County Pickett Butte lookout with similar 1934 CCC details; it is a different site and was not used.
